title: Show duration before/after each rebalance step
author: israelpollak-hub
body:
Request from Rachel Stein, CIO of Bayview Teachers Pension Fund.

Bayview wants the monthly duration report to show portfolio duration at each step of the two-step Q4 rebalance:
- Before step 1 (current: 6.4 years)
- After step 1 (about 6.7 years)
- After step 2 (7.0 years)

This lets the board see the planned path next to the current figures, alongside convexity and the +100 basis points sensitivity.

Owner on our side: Sruly. Joe Smith approves before sending; Maria Delgado reviews the methodology notes.
